_about: XP-remaining estimate inputs, keyed by Timeback course sourcedId (never by title). remaining ≈ sizeXp × (1 − pctCompleteApp/100). sizeXp is JUDGED: a one-time calibration against the Math Academy API on 2026-09-16 over active non-test students with 5–95% progress (median of xpRemaining ÷ (1 − progress) per Math Academy course), then attached to every Timeback course id that maps to that Math Academy course. Math Academy does not publish course sizes and Timeback does not hold them; these retire when Math Academy re-sizes a course and only a Math Academy key can re-derive them.
instrument: mathacademy api beta9, GET /students/{email}: currentCourse.progress, currentCourse.xpRemaining
rules: Look the student's enrollment course.sourcedId up in courses[]; never match on title.
sizeXp present → remaining = sizeXp × (1 − pctCompleteApp/100), basis 'calibrated 2026-09-16'.

sizeXp null and the course is not SAT → remaining_lower = course.metadata.metrics.totalXp × (1 − pctCompleteApp/100), basis 'timeback lower bound' (Timeback's course XP figure is smaller than Math Academy's course size for every course measured).
SAT courses (use = never) → no estimate at all: Math Academy reports an estimated SAT score there, which Timeback never receives, and pctCompleteApp on those courses is stale or absent.
A course id not in courses[] → regenerate the courses reference (GET .../courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy') and treat the course as unsized until then.
accuracy_note: On the calibration day, applied to Timeback's pctCompleteApp, the calibrated estimate was within 25% of Math Academy's own xpRemaining for roughly two thirds of students and within 40% for about three quarters. An order-of-magnitude planning figure, never the exact number Math Academy would show.
